verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Swell's dashboard or product that users can delegate tasks to. The AI page describes tooling for external coding agents: a file contract, the CLI, a validate-deploy-verify loop and a schema endpoint. That is developer building-block support for outside agents, not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
